verdict.rationale: ADP documents API Central, a self-service API product with OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect, use-case API templates, an API discovery tool, and code samples for automating HR processes, so a first-party programmatic surface exists. Nothing shows it reaches parity with the RUN UI, and the evidence never explicitly ties API Central to RUN. The RUN docs instead stress UI, phone, mobile and file-export workflows. missing for 10: evidence that API Central covers RUN specifically, documented API coverage of core RUN actions (running payroll, onboarding, tax forms, reports, bill pay), any stated UI–API parity, write-capable endpoint references, independent hands-on corroboration.
